lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (2/1) to flange (4/3) fold, about 90 deg, large radius. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label point is the outermost point of the outer-skin arc (nearest scan point 0.31/0.17/0.03 mm; min bisector coordinate about 0). The line is parallel to the fold. Points in the apex zone run t=-0.3..58.5 mm against a line length of 58.4 mm, so it covers the full fold from edge to edge with no gaps. The face-on close-up confirms this.
